description_en: Queries a list of file versions
description_zh: 调用ListFileVersions查询文件的版本列表
name: ListFileVersions

parameters.help_en: The file ID. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html to query the file ID
parameters.help_zh:
文件的ID，
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/173942.html查询对应文件的ID
parameters.name: file_id

parameters.help_en: The DataWorks workspace ID. To find this, click the wrench icon in the upper-right corner and navigate to the workspace management page
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的ID，
您可以单击页面右上角的小扳手图标，进入工作空间管理页面查看
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The unique identifier of the DataWorks workspace, which is the identifier at the top of the Data Studio page where you switch workspaces.

Either this parameter or ProjectId must be specified to identify the target DataWorks workspace for this API call
parameters.help_zh:
DataWorks工作空间的唯一标识符，即数据开发页面顶部切换工作空间处的英文标识。


该参数与ProjectId参数二者必须设置其一，以确定本次API调用操作的DataWorks工作空间
parameters.name: project_identifier

parameters.help_zh:
请求的数据页数，
用于翻页
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数，默认为10条，
最大100条
parameters.name: page_size

FileVersions.description_en: The list of file version details

ChangeType.description_en: The change type for this file version. Valid values: CREATE, UPDATE, and DELETE
ChangeType.description_zh: 本次文件版本的变更类型，包括CREATE、UPDATE和DELETE

Comment.description_en: The description of this file version

CommitTime.description_en: The timestamp (in milliseconds) when the file version was created
CommitTime.description_zh: 生成文件版本的毫秒时间戳

CommitUser.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the user who created this file version
CommitUser.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的阿里云用户ID

FileContent.description_en: The file code for this version
FileContent.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文件代码

FileName.description_en: The file name for this file version
FileName.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文件名

FilePropertyContent.description_en: The text information for this file version
FilePropertyContent.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的文本基本信息

IsCurrentProd.description_en:
Indicates whether this file version is the latest version in the production environment.

true

false
IsCurrentProd.description_zh:
本次文件版本是否为当前生产环境的最新版本。

true：是最新版本。
false：不是最新版本

NodeContent.description_en: The scheduling configuration for this file version
NodeContent.description_zh: 生成本次文件版本的调度配置

NodeId.description_en: The scheduling task ID associated with this file version
NodeId.description_zh: 生成文件版本时对应的调度任务ID

Status.description_en: The current status of the file version. Valid values: COMMITTING (committing), COMMITTED or CHECK_OK (committed), PACKAGED (ready for deployment), DEPLOYING (deploying), DEPLOYED (deployed), and CANCELLED (deployment canceled)
Status.description_zh:
文件版本当前的状态，
包括COMMITTING（提交中）、COMMITTED或CHECK_OK（已提交）、PACKAGED（准备发布）、DEPLOYING（发布中）、DEPLOYED（已发布）和CANCELLED（取消发布）

UseType.description_en: The functional module to which the file belongs. Valid values: NORMAL (Data Studio), MANUAL (manual task), MANUAL_BIZ (manual workflow), SKIP (dry-run scheduling in Data Studio), ADHOCQUERY (ad hoc query), and COMPONENT (component management)
UseType.description_zh:
文件所属的功能模块，
包括NORMAL（数据开发）、MANUAL（手动任务）、MANUAL_BIZ（手动工作流）、SKIP（数据开发的空跑调度）、ADHOCQUERY（临时查询）和COMPONENT（组件管理）

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries on the current page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries returned
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足查询条件的数据总条数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the call succeeded. Valid values:

true

false
Success.description_zh:
调用是否成功。取值如下：

true：调用成功。
false：调用失败
